name: Crumbl Cookies
notes: Point Loma location confirmed by address (2990 Midway Dr Suite B). Crumbl sells cookies only by pack size (flavors rotate weekly and are not individually priced/named); the 4 pack-size items are the complete catalog structure, not a truncated carousel. Prices are Uber Eats delivery prices (marketplace), not verified in-store prices.
